title: Flex 170 GPU from Intel - Subscription Free GPU Accelerated VDI on Proxmox 8.1
summary: Level1Techs' Wendell shows Intel's Flex 170 GPU providing GPU-accelerated virtual desktops on Proxmox 8.1 without subscription licensing, using SR-IOV, and demonstrates many desktop instances running at once.
why: Referenced in discussions of GPU virtualization and VDI as a demo of licensing-free GPU sharing.

quote.text: he had 31 virtual desktop instances all running with full GPU acceleration, with RDP as the VDI client software
